title: Couple arrested for sexual abuse of minor in Kodungallur after sending explicit content on Instagram
content: Thrissur: A man and his wife have been arrested on charges of sexually abusing a minor girl in Kodungallur. They were identified as Muhsin (32), a native of Azhikode, and his wife, Dhanalakshmi (22). The incidents reportedly took place between March and June this year. According to the police, Muhsin created a fake Instagram account and sent nude photographs to the 15-year-old girl through the account, using the platform's view-once feature. He also reportedly sent her sexually explicit messages. After deleting the first account, he created another fake account through which the couple allegedly sent the girl videos showing them engaging in sexual activity, again using the view-once feature. In April, the accused couple allegedly engaged in sexual activity in front of the girl at their residence. Muhsin subsequently sexually assaulted the minor, police said. A case has been registered under various sections, including the Protection Of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. The two were produced before a court and remanded to judicial custody.
